combo_label: Things That Beep × Windmills & Watermills × The Blitz

entries.clue: Pianist's pendulum that clicks a strict beat, or the app that beeps it instead
Letters on a warden's badge, standing for air raid precautions
Steady single note sounded once the raiders had passed over
Kept by a wartime club on kitchen waste, half its yield going to the Ministry
Great paddled circle the millstream turns to drive the stones
Timber bolted along the stock, the spine of a single mill arm
Midland city whose cathedral was gutted on the night of 14 November 1940
Deep complaint of old timbers as the cap turns to a new quarter
Toothed ring round the curb that the fan gear walks the cap along
Corrugated steel arch sunk in the garden and covered over with soil
Dashboard direction-giver that bongs, then coldly announces 'Recalculating'.
Little countdown ticker that shrieks the moment your eggs are ready.
Typed pocket note that lands with a double chirp and is answered in emoji
Ping. Pause. Ping. A submarine asking the dark whether anyone is out there.
